scope: s2e01 retake check (D-023 rule 1): s26 attempt 2 (scene D anchor), s14 attempt 2, s16 attempt 2, and attempt 1 of s28 and s29 (made against the new s26). s20 is a second framing of s14 and judged through it. I made none of these frames and generated nothing.
method: Each png probed (all 1440x2560) and viewed whole at 720 wide against its prompt, shots.json STATE and the earlier S9 rejection; then cropped at full resolution with ffmpeg: s26 torso (pouch, pen, bars), token wrist and helmet, Pushpa (wool, bag, bun, spectacles, bar); s14 bottom-left corner measured in raw RGB pixels against the wall colour, and the brass plate measured the same way; s16 face/bars and hands/wool/pockets; s28 register stack and chest (bars, medal); s29 faces, open hand, epaulettes, bulb. s20's window computed from production/remotion/src/camera.ts for its custom move (scale 1.3, x -1 to -0.9, y 1 to 0.9). s16 attempt 1 (s16.prev1.png) viewed beside attempt 2.

summary.rule_11: s26, s14 and s16 have now used their one retake; their attempt-2 takes stand. s28 and s29 passed on attempt 1, so no retake was spent.

s26.fixed: Token string is on the picture-left wrist with Nandini facing us (pouch picture-left, blue pen in the picture-right pocket), so it is her RIGHT wrist as STATE requires; that same hand sets the helmet on the bench; her picture-right hand hangs empty.
s26.checked: Nandini identity (oval face, centre parting, low ponytail, two bars each side), face about 26-31% down; Pushpa one bar each, low round spectacles, bun with crossed needles, wool in the picture-left pocket (her right), picture-right pocket empty, bag on the picture-right shoulder (her left), hands empty; helmet resting on the bench, token blank and beside it; bench on the left wall, blank tokens on the nail, two blank brass-edged frames, high windows with shafts, pillar at picture-right; exactly two people; no text. Pair height: Nandini bends so it cannot be measured directly; Pushpa's head-to-feet span is about 0.89 of Nandini's bent span at the same depth, consistent with the 152/170 cm sheet.
drift: Helmet's left edge about 4% from the picture-left edge (inside the 8% margin); the push-in keeps it in frame.
Pushpa is nearly square to camera rather than three-quarters picture-left.

s14.fixed: Hand and peanut now lie only in the bottom-left corner: top at 76.3% down, right edge at 22.8% across (the 22.8% only at 84% down and below). Pixels of them inside s20's window: 0 at the move's start (23.1-100% x 0-76.9%) and 0 at its end (21.9-98.8% x 1.2-78.1%). Plate measured 29.8-45.0% down, 32.9-83.1% across, which matches the corrected ov_shield.surface in shots.json.
s14.checked: Shield front-on, plate blank with screws and one highlight, damp patch and teal dado as the plate; thumb and finger with one peanut pointing up; no text.
drift: Misses the prompt's own 18% line (22.8%); the margin to s20's window is under 1% across.
Shield drawn larger than asked (about 10-71% down vs 12-54%).

s16.fixed: Orange wool ball now sits in the picture-left pocket (her RIGHT) next to the table, yarn running up to the work; the picture-right pocket is empty. This now matches s23 (wool picture-left) and her lock.
s16.checked: Identity vs take 1 and the lock (round face, frown, low round steel spectacles, grey-streaked high bun with crossed needles), one bar each side, plum sleeveless cardigan, eyes down on the knitting, orange work on bamboo needles at about 46-61% down, face about 23-37% down; envelope with blank violet ring on the table at picture-left; bag on the chair back; doorway, gate and bench geometry as take 1; tube light off; no text.
drift: Nearly square to camera rather than three-quarters picture-left.
Envelope's left end about 2% from the edge (as in take 1); ring stays in frame.

s28.checked: Nirala identity (long face, pencil moustache, earnest eyes), cap level with teal band and black peak, three bars each side, medal picture-right (his left), both hands flat on the sides of the stack, blank slip index with blank tabs on top, stamp and open violet pad picture-left, kettle and two glasses picture-right, blank board and window shaft behind; face about 21-31% down; bottom fifth is the counter's front panel; no text.
drift: EIGHT registers, not nine (l20 says one to nine). Not countable in a 2.5 s push-in, so logged rather than retaken.
Hands shown whole and the uniform reads fitted, not one size too big (same lock drift as s03).
Stack runs to about 74% down (safe band 48-68%) but stays above the subtitle fifth; kettle touches the picture-right edge.

s29.checked: Nirala picture-left, Pushpa picture-right at the same depth (feet level). His open, palm-up hand is on the arm on the picture-right side of his body (his LEFT), with the medal on that side and the holster picture-left; three bars on both epaulettes (the far one foreshortened). Pushpa: wool in the picture-left pocket (her right, towards him), picture-right pocket empty, bag on the picture-right shoulder, hands empty. Heights per the line-up rule: her head top is within about 1% of the frame height of his eyebrows, cap top well above her bun and needles; her span is about 0.93 of his (sheet 152/160 = 0.95). Booth grille door shut; stair rises behind and between them; bulb unlit; faces about 27-35% and 31-38% down; matches s26's drawing of Pushpa; no text.
drift: Sleeves do not cover his hands and the uniform reads fitted (same lock drift as s03/s28).
The nod reads as both looking down towards each other rather than a clear chin dip.

s20.note: The current build_timeline.py still slates s20 because frames/s20.png does not exist; that is the toolsmith's second_framing fix (D-023 rule 3) or an editor mapping, not a frame fault.

not_checked: No render was played or extracted; this check is on the source pngs only.
